text: You just started your truck in the garage to warm it up, and the door is shut.
The exhaust is full of carbon monoxide, and you can't see it or smell it.
You breathe it in, and it grabs your red blood cells over two hundred times harder than oxygen.
Now your blood can't carry oxygen, so your brain and heart start to starve.
First you get a headache, then dizzy and sick to your stomach. It feels like the flu.
Then you get confused and weak, and you can pass out before you make it to the door.
Never run a car in the garage, even with the door open. And if the alarm goes off, get out.
Tag someone who warms up their car in the garage, and subscribe.
